subject: lang-dy
title: LANG.DY.------AFL.
description: Chart 2 of 2 on book p. 84 (WAM-26). LANG-DY (language dynamics) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; AFL (affinity alignment) is the partner. From the subject: POST (postulation), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of", and AFTD (affinity tendencies). From POST: SOC-RT (social reality). From AFTD: RT-INT-TR (reality initiative traits). From SOC-RT: PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) and PHY-U-P (physical universe particular). From PHY-U-P: INDIV-TD (individual tendencies). From INDIV-TD: EXT-FT (extended functionalism).
